title: Public contract shared definitions (v0.2)
description: Reusable public-safe definitions for v0.2 wire objects. These definitions constrain structure only. They do not grant authority, imply a decision, or specify private signing, trust, or admission implementation.

opaqueRef.description: Opaque public reference string. Format, resolution, and storage are out of scope for this public contract.

opaqueRefArray.description: Ordered collection of opaque public references. Duplicate values are not permitted.

verification.description: Self-integrity of this wire object. scheme plus canonicalization plus value bind the exact transmitted contents, excluding only verification.value. A matching digest means this object is unmodified. It does not mean authority, approval, or admission. Private keys, signatures, and trust implementation are out of scope.

scheme.description: Public digest scheme. sha-256 is an integrity hash, not a signature.

canonicalization.description: Public JSON canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS).

value.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the RFC 8785 canonical form of this wire object with verification.value omitted. Exactly 64 characters [0-9a-f].

requestVerification.description: Digest identity of the originating execution-request request. Binds this object to that request. It is not this object's self-integrity.

scope.description: Opaque agreed scope for a request. Reach is exactly the agreed scope and no broader. Additional properties are permitted so implementations may carry operation-specific bounds without this schema enumerating them.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp. v0.1 left format unconstrained; v0.2 examples use ISO-8601.

payload.description: Operation-specific input only. Payload cannot replace or override envelope actor_refs, authority_refs, evidence_refs, resource_revision_refs, scope, verification, or request_verification. Payload data does not become authority by being present.
